message.default: 请求未完成；请根据错误码检查输入或服务状态。
message.title: Message

DateFact.description: Raw date plus optional explicit year/month normalization; no date guessing.
DateFact.title: DateFact

ImportedJob.description: One detail document, before file provenance or database persistence.
ImportedJob.title: ImportedJob

JobCandidate.description:
Imported facts plus caller-supplied storage identity and source versions.

The future read adapter must verify the dataset and row associations. This
pure model neither opens that dataset nor checks source files on disk.
JobCandidate.title: JobCandidate

JobProvenance.description: One stored source version; absolute local source paths stay outside.
JobProvenance.title: JobProvenance

MatchingInput.description: Lossless projection of matching facts, not an evidence-check certificate.
MatchingInput.title: MatchingInput

MatchingRequest.description: An unranked handoff. 'formal' is a review gate, not a match result.
MatchingRequest.title: MatchingRequest

ResumeBlock.description: One text block returned by the PDF engine, with page-local coordinates.
ResumeBlock.title: ResumeBlock

ResumeDocument.description: Structured PDF evidence, before ResumeProfile semantic extraction.
ResumeDocument.title: ResumeDocument

ResumePage.description: Page dimensions/bboxes share PyMuPDF's unrotated coordinate space.
ResumePage.title: ResumePage

ResumeProvenance.description: Timestamp is supplied by the file layer, never invented by the adapter.
ResumeProvenance.title: ResumeProvenance

SearchPreferences.description:
Explicit user choices, not facts inferred from a resume or JD.

None means unspecified. Nonempty city/role lists express alternatives; no
filtering or hard-constraint evaluation is performed at this stage.
SearchPreferences.title: SearchPreferences

SkillEvidence.description: A positive mention, not proof of proficiency or years of experience.
SkillEvidence.title: SkillEvidence

TextFact.description: Value is extracted text, not a generated paraphrase or a capability score.
TextFact.title: TextFact
